name: select
title: Select
description: A select component with multiple variants, sizes, scroll area, and item icons. Uses namespace exports: Select.Root, Select.Trigger, Select.Value, Select.Content, Select.Item, Select.ItemIcon, Select.Group, Select.GroupLabel, Select.Separator, Select.TriggerIcon.

migration.guide: API changed: now uses namespace exports `import * as Select from ...`. Uses tv (tailwind-variants) instead of cva. Uses @remixicon/react instead of react-icons. Removed class-variance-authority dependency. Removed usePortal prop from Content.

docs.lead: A select component with multiple variants, sizes, scroll area, and item icons.
docs.usage:
import * as Select from "@/components/ui/select"

<Select.Root>
  <Select.Trigger>
    <Select.Value placeholder="Select..." />
  </Select.Trigger>
  <Select.Content>
    <Select.Item value="one">Option One</Select.Item>
    <Select.Item value="two">Option Two</Select.Item>
  </Select.Content>
</Select.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.code:
<Select.Root>
  <Select.Trigger>
    <Select.Value placeholder="Select your favorite fruit..." />
  </Select.Trigger>
  <Select.Content>
    <Select.Item value="apple">Apple</Select.Item>
    <Select.Item value="banana">Banana</Select.Item>
  </Select.Content>
</Select.Root>

examples.title: With Label and Hint
examples.description: Select with a label and hint text.
examples.code:
<Label.Root htmlFor="fruit">Fruit</Label.Root>
<Select.Root>
  <Select.Trigger id="fruit">
    <Select.Value placeholder="Select..." />
  </Select.Trigger>
  <Select.Content>
    <Select.Item value="apple">Apple</Select.Item>
  </Select.Content>
</Select.Root>
<Hint.Root>
  <Hint.Icon as={RiInformationFill} />
  This is a hint text.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: With Icons
examples.code:
<Select.Root defaultValue="utility-payment">
  <Select.Trigger>
    <Select.Value placeholder="Select a payment..." />
  </Select.Trigger>
  <Select.Content>
    <Select.Item value="utility-payment">
      <Select.ItemIcon as={RiFlashlightLine} />
      Utility Payment
    </Select.Item>
  </Select.Content>
</Select.Root>

api.name: Select.Root
api.description: The root select container. Provides context for variant, size, and error state.

api.name: Select.Trigger
api.description: The trigger button with auto arrow icon.

api.name: Select.Value
api.description: Displays the selected value or placeholder.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text when no value is selected

api.name: Select.Content
api.description: The dropdown content with scroll area.

api.name: Select.Item
api.description: An individual select option with check indicator.

api.name: Select.ItemIcon
api.description: Icon displayed in a select item.
